title: Single affine chart section localization
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, h:Y → Spec A a scheme morphism, and a,g ∈ A. Suppose V=h⁻¹D(g) is affine and U=h⁻¹D(a) ∩ V. The localization at a of the fixed A-module underlying chartSectionModule h g [def-sbc-punctured-completion-chart-section-modules] is A-linearly equivalent to Γ(Y,U), with structural A-action. The equivalence sends m/1 to restriction of m from V to U. Localization and restriction of scalars have the meanings in [def-weil-pbc-formal-glueing-data].

source.place: Tag 0BLH, first proof paragraph; Tag 05EL, item (1).

proof.text: Define the concrete structural ring maps φ:A→Γ(Y,V), ψ:A→Γ(Y,U), and restriction ρ:Γ(Y,V)→Γ(Y,U). Presheaf functoriality proves ρ∘φ=ψ. chartSectionModule_smul identifies the fixed chart A-action with multiplication through φ, giving an identity-on-elements A-linear equivalence e₀ to Γ(Y,V) with algebra structure φ.

Scheme.basicOpen_res, Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top and basicOpen_eq_of_affine identify U with Y.basicOpen(φ(a)). IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_of_eq_basicOpen gives IsLocalization.Away(φ(a)) Γ(Y,U) with restriction algebra map. Algebra.algebraMapSubmonoid_powers and the IsLocalizedModule instance of Mathlib.Algebra.Module.LocalizedModule.IsLocalization give the corresponding A-module localization property for restriction; transport the source through e₀ using IsLocalizedModule.of_linearEquiv_right.
Apply IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv to the standard localized module and the restriction map composed with e₀. IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv_apply yields the formula on m/1.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_chart_section_localization
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {Y : Scheme.{u}} (h : Y ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    (a g : A) (hV : IsAffineOpen (h ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g))
    (U : Y.Opens) (hU : U = (h ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen a) ⊓
      (h ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen g)) :
    letI : Module A Γ(Y, U) := Module.compHom _
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫ h.appTop ≫
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
    ∃ e : FormalGlueing.localize a (FormalGlueing.piece g (chartSectionModule h g)) ≃ₗ[A]
        Γ(Y, U),
      ∀ m, e (LocalizedModule.mk m 1) =
        Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE (hU.le.trans inf_le_right)).op m
